title: music.track v1
description: Cached metadata for a music track seen through a provider. Item IDs are deterministic: random bits from the first 80 bits of sha256('provider|providerUri') for the first provider seen, so watchers upsert instead of duplicating. Payloads carry only stable metadata - volatile provider fields (popularity, available_markets, preview_url, is_playable, restrictions) are excluded, and watchers upsert only when a stable field changed. Album art must be downloaded into a blob (attachment role 'artwork'); previewImage.url is provenance only and will rot.

releaseDate.description: Verbatim provider string; the format is self-describing precision ('1981', '1981-12', '1981-12-04').

providerIds.description: Provider-specific IDs or URIs, e.g. spotify: 'spotify:track:...'.

previewImage.description: Provenance record of the provider's artwork URL. The durable copy is the 'artwork' attachment blob.
